intro: Between 13 April and 1 May 2026, ZCyberNews published 28 articles under the threat-intelligence tag, with a severity mix of 12 informational, 10 high, and 3 medium reports. The most frequently covered threat actors were Commercial Surveillance Vendors, GopherWhisper, and Handala Hack. Affected sectors included government, technology, financial services, civil society, and critical-infrastructure, while impacted regions spanned Global, Asia, Europe, Iran, and North America.
